scenario.topic: Decide how to distribute rehearsal time across a theater production

options.name: Equal Time for All Scenes
options.upside: Ensures all scene types receive equal attention.
options.concern: May not address more complex scenes needing extra practice.

options.name: Focus on Group Scenes
options.upside: Improves coordination among cast members in group scenes.
options.concern: Reduces time for individual role preparation and technical checks.

options.name: Emphasize Technical Run-Throughs
options.upside: Helps identify and fix technical issues early.
options.concern: Less rehearsal time for acting and character development.

options.name: Prioritize Individual Practice
options.upside: Allows actors to develop their roles thoroughly.
options.concern: May limit group interaction and technical coordination.

shared_context: A theater production team of 7 must allocate 20 total hours of rehearsal time. The goal is to balance individual practice, group scenes, and technical run-throughs to prepare efficiently for opening night.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a collaborative stage manager focused on group dynamics.
personas.private_goal: Ensure strong group cohesion to enhance overall performance.

A.reason_for: Balanced rehearsal ensures all scene types get attention.
A.reason_against: May not give enough time to group scenes which are critical for cohesion.

B.reason_for: Focus on group scenes improves coordination among cast members.

C.reason_for: Technical precision is important for a smooth show.
C.reason_against: Too little group rehearsal may hurt cast chemistry.

D.reason_for: Individual practice helps actors develop roles.
D.reason_against: Limits group interaction which Maya values highly.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a lead actor who prefers thorough individual preparation.
personas.private_goal: Master my role to deliver a flawless performance.

A.reason_for: Balanced time allows some individual practice.
A.reason_against: Not enough focus on individual preparation for my role.

B.reason_for: Group cohesion helps scenes flow well.

C.reason_for: Technical run-throughs are useful but less relevant to my focus.
C.reason_against: Cuts into individual and group rehearsal time.

D.reason_for: Prioritizes individual practice, perfect for mastering roles.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is a pragmatic director who values balanced preparation.
personas.private_goal: Ensure all aspects of the production are well rehearsed.

A.reason_for: Equal time for all scenes ensures no area is neglected.

B.reason_for: Group scenes are important for ensemble work.
B.reason_against: Less individual practice could weaken actors.

C.reason_for: Technical run-throughs help catch issues early.
C.reason_against: Less time for acting and character development.

D.reason_for: Individual practice is valuable but not the only focus.
D.reason_against: May limit group and technical rehearsals.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a technical director focused on flawless production quality.
personas.private_goal: Minimize technical errors to ensure a smooth show.

A.reason_for: Balanced rehearsal covers technical needs adequately.
A.reason_against: Could use more focus on technical run-throughs.

C.reason_for: Emphasizing technical run-throughs helps catch and fix issues early.

D.reason_for: Individual practice is important but not my priority.

personas.name: Zara
personas.background: Zara is a quiet but focused actor who values personal role mastery.
personas.private_goal: Perfect my lines and character to feel confident on stage.

personas.private_goal: Use rehearsal time effectively to nail my role.

C.reason_for: Technical run-throughs are less relevant to my goals.

D.reason_for: Maximizes individual practice time for role mastery.

personas.name: Tess

D.reason_for: Prioritizes individual practice, essential for my preparation.
